# PANACEA Hash Garden

> Premium 21+ smoke shop and botanical apothecary in Corpus Christi, Texas. PANACEA carries hemp-derived THC seltzers, house-made edibles, artisan glass, accessories, and branded merch. It's also a community venue hosting comedy, live music, and local art & vendor markets.

- Address: 4914 Everhart Rd, Corpus Christi, TX 78411
- Phone: (361) 752-4168
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 10 AM–10 PM, closed Sunday
- Age policy: 21+ only
- Founder: Rene Pena
- Sales model: botanicals in-store only (no online checkout); branded merch ships nationwide via https://panaceahg.printful.me/

## Pages

- [Home](https://panaceastx.com/): Overview of the shop, categories, events, merch, and location
- [Products](https://panaceastx.com/products): In-store catalog — hemp-derived THC drinks, homemade edibles, artisan glass, accessories
- [Events](https://panaceastx.com/events): Backyard comedy nights, live music, art & vendor markets, events calendar, and performer/vendor booking
- [Merch](https://panaceastx.com/merch): PANACEA-branded apparel (hoodies, caps, jackets, tees, backpacks) shipped via the online store, plus original paintings from local Corpus Christi artists in-store
- [About](https://panaceastx.com/about): Founder Rene Pena's story, the "grown, made, crafted" philosophy, and the approach to cannabis genetics and cultivation
- [Contact](https://panaceastx.com/contact): Location map, hours, phone, and message form

## Notes

- PANACEA sells federally legal hemp-derived products to adults 21 and over in compliance with applicable Texas law; product selection changes as Texas hemp regulations evolve.
- The shop cultivates its own hemp and produces its own edibles for transparency and quality control.
